title: pp.spacer~
description: `pp.spacer~` combines functionality like `pp.doppler~` and `pp.pan~` to spatialize an input signal from X and Y trajectory signals, producing stereo dry and wet outputs. Its additional wet outputs can feed `pp.rev~` or other effects, with wet-signal amplitude modulation and stereo localization available; it can also save and recall up to 20 presets with the parent patch.
